$ edit testdata/export/prices.txtar  # products no bytes lift makes, and a known gap in parse's cell
$ go test  # strip-a
    testdata/export/prices.txtar: no registry claims via/nobody/quote/A1 and variant/doubled/via/nobody/quote/A1: no bytes lift named nobody runs over the corpus export.
        If a bytes lift should write them, register it. If not, run hypercase strip -column nobody at the module root, then FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... until it changes nothing. The strip removes nobody's sections from every archive under the module-root corpus, and the update writes back each one a registry claims, but not one whose cell the update writes nothing for, such as a cell that faults.
    testdata/export/prices.txtar: no registry claims via/parse/quote/A1: no bytes lift named parse runs over the corpus export.
        If a bytes lift should write them, register it. If not, run hypercase strip -column parse at the module root, then FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... until it changes nothing. The strip removes parse's sections from every archive under the module-root corpus, and the update writes back each one a registry claims, but not one whose cell the update writes nothing for, such as a cell that faults.
